[ffff64]Wind Ark[ffffff]
This ship seems to have been been abandoned for\nquite some time but there's almost no serious\ndamage...God's creation is really something!
Umm? What's that??
Since it's ornamented, I have a feeling that\nsomething good is inside ♪...Huh?\nIt's locked. In that case...
Cule's special Metamo Key!
Hoaaaamm~...What a purr-fect sleep...
Oh my gosh?!\nMeow?!
W-w-w-what are you?!
You're the suspicious one, you meow!\nNo one is allowed to enter the Wind Ark without\nStormia's consent!!
What?! We were having a hard time searching for\nthe ark and just lifted it up when we finally\nfound it, you know!!
It wasn't that damaged, moreover, if we hadn't\nlifted it up, you wouldn't have been able to come\nout. How could you talk to us like that?!
W-what the meow...\nSo the ark has been invaded...\nStop whatefur you're scheming right meow!!
Please calm down. At least we're not your foes.\nWe only came here to search for the crashed ark to\nlift it up.
Did you say crashed?! So, what about Stormia who\nwas steering the ark...? Stormia, the Goddess of\nWind, where's she meow?!
She's missing and nobody knows where she is now...
Fur real?! No way...
By the way, what are you?!\nYou were inside a box that was locked for a long\ntime, so you must not be human, aren't you?
I'm Navie...\nI'm Stormia's deputy. Ensuring a smooth and safe\nsailing is meow duty...
A-are you a god?! You said you're Stormia's\ndeputy, right? Grecia also said that she's a\ndeputy god. What's actually a deputy god?
Deputy gods are gods that assist the 12 holy gods.\nEach of the 12 gods has 1 or 2 deputies.
Stormia is the one who steers this ark and I'm\nher deputy who makes sure that it sails smoothly\nand safely...
Hmmm...but to me, you simply look like a Diel\nthat is just a little bit different...
Hmmm...but to me, you simply look like a Diel\nthat is just a little bit different...Oh wait?
You said you're a god that makes sure that the\nark sails safely? So you know how to navigate\nthis ship...?
Unfur-tunately, meow job is only to ensure that it\nsails smoothly, I have no idea how to navigate it\nat all ♪
Hmm...What do you say if we go back to Nov\nSaterica and try asking Kunon if there is\nsomeone else who could navigate the ark?
Although she's young, she's also one of the 12\nholy gods...
Kunon? It sounds fur-miliar...Okay, whatefur.\nI'mma take another nap while watching this place.\nDon't make meow wait too long!
Are you really a god?\nAll I can see is a giant kitten...\nWell, whatever. Let's hurry to Nov Saterica!
What took mew so long?\nI'm feline tired from sleeping too much...\nOh? I feel like I've seen this...
Long time no see, Navie!
Oh, um...er...who are mew...again?
I'm Kunon, it's me Kunon! Obligaus' daughter!!\nOh well, it's only natural that you have a vague\nmemory of me.
Because most of the time you were sleeping while I\nwas learning to navigate the ark from Aunt\nStormia.
Paw-don me?! You're Kunon?! That little girl?!\nOh wow...! I must have slept for centuries...
All right, I'll try to navigate it.\nIt's been a while since I last did this,\nso watch out cuz the ark may shake a lot!
Oh my, oh my goshhh!!
Oh meow, meow, meow, meowww!!
Meow!!
I'm doing my best to keep the hull steady...\nFor now I think it's better to sail toward\nEl Scaro and get it fixed there.
Why El Scaro though? Oh gosh!\n...Isn't Nov Saterica closer...?
There are no facilities or...argh?!\ntools to fix...ugg...\nsuch complicated machine in Nov Saterica!!
It kinda makes me feel better since...oh gosh!\nyou're confident with your statement...oh my my!\nL-let's get to El Scaro quickly then!!
Aye, let's gooo!
